The BASE II software Visa supplies to processors to validate interchange data,
produce the file containing interchange data to be sent from the processor to
Visa, and process incoming transactions received from Visa. The Edit Package
is the interface between a processing center’s internal processing systems
and its Extended Access Server (EAS).

A fee paid by issuers and acquirers to each other for transactions entered
into interchange (and their reversals) to balance the cost of doing business.

The standard input/output data medium for the BASE II Interchange Control
System (ICS). All output from BASE II is delivered to the Visa client on an
incoming ITF. All input to BASE II is sent from the member to the ICS on an
outgoing ITF.

An optional additional currency fee requested by the issuer and collected as
part of the billing amount, if desired by the issuer. This fee is not included in
the settlement amount. It may be a debit or credit.

be directly processed by the endpoint.

changes.old:
An optional regional fee paid by the acquirer when a transaction occurs
outside the issuer's country. It may be assessed for Sales Draft (TC 05)
original and dispute response financial, Cash Disbursement (TC 07) original
and dispute response financial, TC 05 and TC 07 reversals and their SMS Visa
or Plus Network equivalent transactions.
changes.new:
An optional regional fee paid by the acquirer when a transaction occurs
outside the issuer's country. It may be assessed for Sales Draft (TC 05)
original and dispute response financial, Cash Disbursement (TC 07) original
and dispute response financial, TC 05 and TC 07 reversals and their V.I.P. full
financial Visa or Plus Network equivalent transactions.
changes.ai_reason: El texto nuevo menciona 'V.I.P. full financial Visa' en lugar de 'financial' en el contexto de transacciones, lo que sugiere un cambio en el tipo de transacción cubierto por la tarifa.

changes.old:
The International Service Assessment (ISA) fee applies to international BASE II
and SMS clearing transactions in which the issuer country is different from
the merchant country.
changes.new:
The International Service Assessment (ISA) fee applies to international BASE II
and V.I.P. full financial clearing transactions in which the issuer country is
different from the merchant country.
changes.ai_reason: El cambio especifica que las transacciones son 'V.I.P. full financial clearing' en lugar de 'SMS clearing', lo que modifica la condición de aplicación del fee ISA.

changes.old:
A client financial institution that issues Visa cards. For a given transaction, the
issuer is the institution that issued the card used for that transaction to the .
The issuer is responsible for maintaining the accounts of its account holders,
for providing authorization decisions, for account holder billing, and for
settlement of transactions its account holders have with merchants and cash
dispensing locations of other clients. Each issuer operates or designates an
issuer center to perform the functions related to and of transactions.
changes.new:
A client financial institution that issues Visa cards. For a given transaction, the
issuer is the institution that issued the card used for that transaction to the
account holder. The issuer is responsible for maintaining the accounts of its
account holders, for providing authorization decisions, for account holder
billing, and for settlement of transactions its account holders have with
merchants and cash dispensing locations of other clients. Each issuer
operates or designates an issuer center to perform the functions related to
clearing and settlement of interchange transactions.
changes.ai_reason: El texto nuevo especifica que el issuer realiza funciones relacionadas con el clearing y el settlement de transacciones de intercambio, mientras que el texto viejo menciona solo funciones relacionadas con transacciones, lo que cambia el significado de negocio.

changes.old:
A file of cardholder account records, created by Visa every week for
international users, that contains all BASE I Exception File pickup accounts
coded for a given CRB region, plus specified "Region 0" accounts listed by
issuers in that CRB region. Users receive an RCRF as part of the incoming
BASE II interchange transaction file.
changes.new:
A file of cardholder account records, created by Visa every week for
international users, that contains all V.I.P. Exception File pickup accounts
coded for a given CRB region, plus specified "Region 0" accounts listed by
issuers in that CRB region. Users receive an RCRF as part of the incoming
BASE II interchange transaction file.
changes.ai_reason: El texto cambia 'BASE I Exception File' por 'V.I.P. Exception File', lo que altera el significado del archivo en el contexto de Visa.

changes.old:
The actual transfer of funds from the issuing bank to the acquiring bank
through a wire transfer to a settlement account, and the total amount owed
by one Visa client to another. See also .
changes.new:
The actual transfer of funds from the issuing bank to the acquiring bank
through a wire transfer to a settlement account, and the total amount owed
by one Visa client to another. See also net settlement amount.
changes.ai_reason: El texto describe lo mismo, solo se agregó el término 'net settlement amount' en lugar de un fragmento de texto cortado.

changes.old:
A fee charged on transactions from International Airlines when the , , and
transaction countries are different entities. This fee is collected instead of the
IAF fee, and is paid to the transaction region.
changes.new:
A fee charged on transactions from International Airlines when the issuer,
acquirer, and transaction countries are different entities. This fee is collected
instead of the IAF fee, and is paid to the transaction region.
changes.ai_reason: El texto describe lo mismo pero cambió 'the , , and' por 'the issuer, acquirer, and' para corregir una coma y mejorar la claridad.

changes.old:
For BASE I processing. The function operating at all VICs that provides
authorization decisions on behalf of BASE I card issuers. It acts for
transactions in amounts below the issuer limit, when the issuer center is
unavailable, when a request sent to the issuer center times out, or when a
local switch request STIP processing.
For SMS processing. The function that makes authorization decisions for
authorization and financial requests on behalf of issuer centers. It acts only
when the issuer center is unavailable or when a request has timed out.
changes.new:
For V.I.P. processing. The function operating at all VICs that provides
authorization decisions on behalf of card issuers. It acts for transactions in
amounts below the issuer limit, when the issuer center is unavailable, when a
request sent to the issuer center times out, or when a local switch request
STIP processing.
changes.ai_reason: El texto nuevo cambia 'BASE I' por 'V.I.P.' en el contexto de procesamiento, lo que altera el significado de negocio para el tipo de procesamiento.
disappeared_content: For SMS processing. The function that makes authorization decisions for authorization and financial requests on behalf of issuer centers. It acts only when the issuer center is unavailable or when a request has timed out.

changes.new:
